The '''Ion engine initializer''' was a part of an [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]]. The transport [[Borealis]] had a problem with its ion engine initializer when attempting to evacuate [[Folor Base]] before the oncoming attack of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit|Trigit]] in his [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|Implacable]].
